proposed.explanation: All financial figures in the provided ABUK evidence are marked AMBIGUOUS. Per instructions, these must not be used in calculations. The rows (p2-01, p2-02, p2-25, p2-26, p2-31, p2-32) all report revenue, net profit, and EPS for the nine months ended 30 September 2026 and 2025, but the unit ambiguity ('مليار' vs 'مليون') and the AMBIGUOUS tag mean none of the printed numbers can be relied upon. Furthermore, the report only covers nine months; no full-year 2026 earnings data is available in usable form. Consequently, I cannot calculate full-year EPS or a price-to-earnings ratio, and I cannot assess whether the share at 76.21 EGP is cheap. The investor's goal of income/growth from an exporter over a 3–5 year horizon with medium risk tolerance cannot be served by this evidence alone. A responsible decision requires a full-year report with clear, non-ambiguous figures and a stated unit basis. Until then, no buy, hold, or sell recommendation can be responsibly issued.
